stem: A jeepney driver earned ₱1,250 on Monday, ₱980 on Tuesday, ₱1,120 on Wednesday, ₱1,340 on Thursday, ₱1,060 on Friday and ₱1,450 on Saturday. What was his average earning per day?
hints: He worked 6 days, Monday to Saturday. Find the total, then divide.
Add the six amounts in easy pairs: ₱1,250 + ₱1,450, then ₱980 + ₱1,120, then ₱1,340 + ₱1,060.
The pairs make ₱2,700, ₱2,100 and ₱2,400. Add them, then divide the total by 6.

steps.action: Pair up amounts that are easy to add: ₱1,250 + ₱1,450 = ₱2,700.
steps.why: No calculator on exam day. Endings like 50 + 50 or 80 + 20 make round numbers, which are easier to add.

steps.action: His average earning was ₱1,200 per day.

trapNotes.₱1,215: This is halfway between the highest (₱1,450) and the lowest (₱980) only. Use all six days.
trapNotes.₱1,440: This is ₱7,200 ÷ 5. He worked 6 days, Monday to Saturday, so divide by 6.
trapNotes.₱7,200: This is his total for the week. Divide it by 6 to get the amount per day.
